# Part 2 — readiness, recovery, and staged boundaries

The readiness cases tested whether the workflow preserves useful evidence, asks only for the nearest
missing result, and keeps future scale or release work outside the current boundary. E02 resumed at
the missing Journey result. E34 required measurable scale evidence. E37 kept downstream gates closed.
E41 mapped useful legacy Gate 4.5 material forward without repeating it and reopened only stale reach
evidence.

trigger. Its current evaluation is PASS at
